card.name: Start of drug and iron words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a split word such as 'dr' or 'DR' before 'ug', often in all-caps warnings. It also fires on 'ferr' and 'str' at the start of ferric, ferritin and strontium.

modes.label: Dr before ug
modes.description: The 'dr' piece of 'drug' or 'drugs', in lowercase, capitalised or all-caps form.
modes.example: ESPECIALLY WHEN THE<< DR>>UG IS GIVEN SOON AFTER THE USE

modes.label: Ferr and str word starts
modes.description: The opening piece of iron or strontium terms.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with word endings such as 'ung', 'uga' and 'agr', which fits finishing a word like 'drug'.
card.plain: It marks the first chunk of a word like 'drug' or 'ferric' that is split into pieces, so the rest can follow.
